title: Si: band unfolding of the 8-atom cubic cell onto the fcc zone
summary: An environment-dependent Slater-Koster (EDTB) model of silicon with s, p and d orbitals on the 8-atom conventional cubic cell: its bands unfolded onto the Brillouin zone of the 2-atom fcc cell, each state weighted by its spectral weight, for the perfect cell and for a cell with a +1 eV impurity potential on one atom. No DFT run; about a minute.

steps.label: Unfold the bands of the perfect and the perturbed 8-atom cell onto the fcc zone
steps.note: prints the supercell matrix, the atom mapping and the sum rule; writes si_unfolded.npz
